Brightline Media: audience continuity and community engagement.

Community Voices — Local conversations need local voices. We help them speak up.
Legacy Presence — Keep long-running accounts warm and consistent, even when the original team has moved on.
Sentiment Programs — Measurable shifts in how communities feel about the things that matter to you.

Suite 400, 18 Harbor Street, Port Calder · Client portal: portal.bl-ops.net

Calvin Marsh, Founder & CEO — Calvin has spent fifteen years helping brands find their voice.
Renee Okafor, Head of Operations — Renee keeps everything running, always.
…and our amazing community team!
[Photo: team offsite, eleven smiling people on a lawn]

Community Writer (Persona) — remote, part-time.
Write in the voices of real community members. You'll own 4–6 personas, each with a detailed style guide. Must be comfortable with continuity work, including established accounts with history. Discretion essential. NDA required.
Apply: careers@bl-ops.net
